name: GRIEVANCE
note: GRIEVANCE, IN BLACK (doc 05: 'in the hearse harness, wearing black well'). The mule in her black plume and harness, hitched to the hearse (a prop, room-31-hearse). Errata 361: she is the gate's Grievance (content/ambient/procession-hearse.json's sheet), turned to face the side-on hearse's front, scaled to the man where she stands and snapped to the one level, her shaft stub at its front wheel; she and the hearse stand up the slope behind the grave (tools/art/acts-two-to-four-cut.py grievance_gate).
